items.exampleEn: The ending of the story was predictable from the first page.
items.exampleZh: 那個故事的結局從第一頁就猜得到。

items.exampleEn: She is a strong proponent of free school meals.
items.exampleZh: 她大力支持學校提供免費餐點。

items.exampleEn: He is known for his quick wit.
items.exampleZh: 他以反應快、說話風趣出名。

items.exampleEn: What a coincidence! We booked the same hotel.
items.exampleZh: 真巧！我們訂了同一家飯店。

items.exampleEn: Comparing the brain to a computer is a common analogy.

items.exampleEn: I was unaware that the shop had closed.
items.exampleZh: 我不知道那家店已經關了。

items.exampleEn: Past sales are a useful predictor of future sales.
items.exampleZh: 過去的銷售數字是預測未來銷售的好指標。

items.exampleEn: It's sensible to carry an umbrella in spring.
items.exampleZh: 春天隨身帶把傘是明智的。

items.sentenceEn: Many drivers are still unaware of the new speed limit.
items.sentenceZh: 很多駕駛還不知道新的速限。

items.audioEn: Our cat is very predictable: it waits by the door at six every evening.
items.audioZh: 我們家的貓很好預測：牠每天傍晚六點都在門邊等。
options: It waits by the window all day

items.sentenceEn: Wearing a helmet on a bike is the sensible choice.
items.sentenceZh: 騎腳踏車戴安全帽是明智的選擇。

items.sentenceEn: Her sharp wit made the long meeting much more fun.
items.sentenceZh: 她敏捷的機智讓冗長的會議變得有趣多了。

items.stemEn: The teacher made a clever ____ between electricity and water moving through pipes.
items.stemZh: 老師把電和流過水管的水做了一個巧妙的類比。

items.stemEn: Wearing headphones, he was completely ____ of the car horn behind him.
items.stemZh: 他戴著耳機，完全沒察覺後面的汽車喇叭聲。

items.passageEn: My grandfather is a proponent of old ways of guessing the weather. He says that a red sky in the evening is a good predictor of a sunny day, and that cows lie down before rain. When I told him the weather report on the radio was more reliable, he answered with his usual wit: "The radio has never been outside." Last week he said the weather would be foul the next day, and it rained all morning. Maybe it was just a coincidence, but I had to admit he was right. He explained his ideas with an analogy: reading the sky is like reading a friend's face. Still, I think the sensible thing is to listen to both him and the radio.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺支持用老方法猜天氣。他說傍晚天空發紅，是隔天會出太陽的好預兆，還說牛躺下來就表示要下雨了。我跟他說收音機的氣象報告比較可靠，他用一貫的風趣回答：「收音機又沒出過門。」上週他說隔天天氣會很差，結果整個早上都在下雨。也許只是巧合，但我不得不承認他說對了。他用一個比喻解釋他的想法：看天空就像看朋友的臉色。不過，我覺得最明智的做法，是爺爺和廣播的說法都參考。

questions.questionZh: 作者說廣播比較可靠時，爺爺怎麼回答？
options: 開玩笑說收音機從沒出過門

questions.questionZh: 作者認為最明智的做法是什麼？

items.promptZh: 我叔叔一直都支持騎腳踏車上班。
referenceEn: My uncle has always been a proponent of cycling to work.
My uncle has long been a proponent of riding a bike to work.
rubricZh: proponent 的用法，例如 a proponent of cycling、a proponent of riding a bike 等
時態合理（例如 has always been、has long been 等）

items.promptZh: 這座城市夏天的天氣很好預測：每天下午都會下雨。
referenceEn: The summer weather in this city is predictable: it rains every afternoon.
In this city, summer weather is very predictable, because it rains every afternoon.
rubricZh: predictable 可放 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 is predictable、predictable weather 等）
「每天下午都會下雨」可寫，例如 it rains every afternoon 等；用現在式表示常態
